name: Innok Robotics INDUROS 700
summary: Autonomous outdoor-capable tugger robot from Regenstauf, Germany, that tows pallet trolleys, mesh boxes or trailers of up to 700 kg between halls and yard over gravel, thresholds and 10 % slopes. The construction company Markgraf uses an INDUROS in its logistics and mobility centre in Kemnath.

germany.statusNote: Made and sold in Germany by Innok Robotics, directly and through sales and integration partners, for purchase or as Robot-as-a-Service; prices and terms on request.

sellers.name: Innok Robotics GmbH
sellers.note: Regenstauf near Regensburg. Purchase or Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS); price on request.

specs.label: Trailer load
specs.conditions: depending on ground, route and speed; other models 350 kg (350s) and 1,300 kg (1300)

specs.label: Size (L × W × H)
specs.quote: Dimensions: 115 x 80 x 100 cm (L x W x H)

specs.label: Max. gradient
specs.quote: IP65, –10 °C to +45 °C, gradients up to 10%, asphalt and gravel

specs.label: Battery
specs.conditions: 48 V Li-ion; charging 20–80 % in about 2 h, autonomous inductive charging

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: up to, depending on payload and route
specs.quote: Runtime: up to 16 hours, depending on payload and route

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: lidar, optional RTK GNSS; Innok COCKPIT browser software; VDA 5050 interface

notes: A tugger: it tows trolleys and trailers (automatic coupling) rather than carrying loads on its own deck, so carryPayloadKg is left empty.
Drives over thresholds, potholes, gravel and asphalt in rain and snow (maker); rough ground means yard surfaces, not open terrain.
Safety laser scanner, beacon, warning tone and emergency stop.
